sections.heading: TAPG.JK — Triputra Agro Persada
sections.markdown:
**Regime vs macro frontmatter:** PLANTATION / CPO sits under the desk's "commodity bloc as one beta" NEUTRAL tilt — underwrite name-by-name, do not chase. No desk tailwind, no headwind: the thesis must stand on its own.

**Screen signal / why now:** #11 INDO NEGLECTED — mom12 +62.9%, −21.6% off the 52w high, ADV IDR 52B, thin coverage. Palm oil + derivatives are ~100% of revenue; TTM net margin 34%, P/E 9.5, fwd 9.3, ~9.4% dividend yield (stockanalysis.com, 2026-10-05). A cash-generative CPO mid-cap, meaningfully off its high, still poorly covered.

**Archetype:** `commodity_capex_turnaround` (rate 0.42, +75/−35, 3y). Method card: VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL.

**Deep-dive must answer:**
1. Estate age / CPO-yield profile — is the +63%/12m a palm-price re-rate (sector beta) or company-specific volume/cost gains?
2. At what CPO price does FCF cover the ~9.4% payout — how much of the dividend survives a price down-cycle?
3. Is the −22% off-high pullback a cycle-turn signal or a re-set inside an intact up-leg?

**Fast-disqualify:**
- EV positive at base rate? YES — 0.42×75 − 0.58×35 = **+11.2%**.
- Valuation-anchored target clears entry? YES (plausible) — through-cycle CPO-cost NAV + dividend capacity, never spot-price anchored.
- Sources reachable? YES — IDX filings, CPO price feeds; network reachable.

**Prior kill:** T-INDO-TAPG-001 killed 2026-08-19 (valuation) @1,830; now 1,920 — above the kill, so this is a fresh look, not a below-entry revisit.

**PROMOTED 2026-10-10 (WEEKLY_DEEP)** — consumed as an INDO deep-dive; advanced to construction chain T-INDO-TAPG-002. Reason: cash-generative NEGLECTED CPO mid-cap (34% TTM net margin, P/E 9.5, ~9.4% yield, −22% off high); the chain must test the +63%/12m as palm-price beta vs company-specific, and dividend coverage at down-cycle CPO.

**DISCARDED 2026-10-12 (consumed).** T-INDO-TAPG-002 judged KILL 2026-10-10 (EV ≈ 1.5%/yr < the 6.5% FR hurdle). Judge-kill cooldown (60d) runs from the 2026-10-12 kill_ledger entry → ~2026-12-11. Downgraded PROMOTED→DISCARD per the consumed convention.
